cf.davTip: Watch out for full-width ！ instead of ! — they look alike but the server will always return 401. Use "Show" below to double-check.

cf.probeModeTip: Light = TCP port check only, never wakes sleeping disks (default). Full = real directory listing, detects file-level issues but touches the disk. Process = zero traffic, only checks that the mount process is alive.
cf.s3Tip: Bucket can be left empty (browse after mounting). MinIO and most self-hosted gateways need "Force path-style" — picking the matching preset sets it automatically.
cf.sysProxyTip: Mounting and probing use the proxy configured in your system settings

st.bundleNote: Updating the manager to the latest release automatically brings the bundled rclone and WinFsp installer up to the official versions shipped with that release: rclone takes effect on the next mount, and WinFsp can be installed with one click above.
st.depsTip: rclone updates download the official release and unpack it into the app config directory; it takes priority over the bundled version on the next mount. Installing WinFsp requires administrator approval (one UAC prompt).
st.exportNote: Exports a JSON file; passwords are included in rclone-obscured form (not plaintext)
st.importNote: Entries whose name matches an existing connection are skipped
st.langNote: Follow the system language by default, or pick one manually
st.latencyNote: A single probe slower than this counts as "unstable network" (yellow)
st.logNote: Log files exceeding the size limit or retention days are cleaned up automatically
st.needAutostart: Takes effect only when "Launch at startup" is on
st.probeNote: Probes use rclone's real protocol stack; results are written into each connection's mount log
st.silentNote: When launched at boot, stay in the system tray without showing the main window; manual launches always show it
st.subtitle: Changes take effect after saving. Upgrading or reinstalling never touches these settings.
st.title: Settings
st.updateNote: Update sources are hosted overseas (GitHub / rclone.org); update checks follow the system proxy. If you see HTTP 403, the shared IP's anonymous quota is likely exhausted — retry later or download from the releases page.
stats.measureTip: Runs one full probe: a real directory listing, so it reflects read/write latency. One-off only — not part of the periodic probes. It reads the directory once, which wakes a sleeping disk.
stats.noHistory: Not enough samples yet — the chart appears after a few probes
stats.probeNa: Process-only monitor: network latency not measured
stats.resetTip: Zero the session traffic, peak and transfer count so you can measure a single copy (does not affect the mount)
stats.tcpNote: Light probe only performs a port handshake — typically under 1 ms. It does not represent directory read/write latency. Switch this connection to “Full” if you want the real figure.
stats.title: Node overview
stats.totalHint: Counted since this mount started, reads and writes combined. It includes repeated reads, retries and read-ahead, so it can exceed the actual file size. Use ↺ to zero it before measuring a single copy.
